summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of admin-only account provisioning (v8). All 17 backend pytest tests passed (register removed→404, admin CRUD users, self-protection on demote/deactivate, forced password change, deactivation blocks login + existing sessions, teacher 403 on /api/admin/*, reset-password sets must_change_password). All frontend flows verified: /connexion shows no-register-notice and no tab-register; admin login → nav-users-link visible → /enseignant/comptes table loads; new teacher creation flow captures temp password + toast shows it; role toggle (Enseignant·e ↔ Admin badge), deactivate→'Désactivé', reactivate; self-row role+active buttons disabled; teacher first login redirects to /enseignant/mot-de-passe, navigating to /enseignant redirects back; after password change teacher lands on /enseignant with no 'Comptes' nav link; teacher visiting /enseignant/comptes directly redirects to /enseignant.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby (a11y console warning only, not blocking)

action_items: (Optional) Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby={undefined} suppression on DialogContent for Create user & Profile dialogs to silence Radix a11y warning.
(Optional) Users table shows legacy TEST_* accounts from previous iterations (10 rows) — consider a cleanup script to remove inactive test users.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 219 public_user: good, excludes password_hash via projection. OK.
change_password returns {**user, must_change_password: False} — user dict comes from current_teacher which already strips password_hash. OK.
admin_update_user: 'if upd' guards empty updates but silently returns 200 on no-op — acceptable.
No rate limit on admin endpoints (not required, admin-only).
ProtectedRoute correctly forces /enseignant/mot-de-passe when must_change_password; Users.jsx also client-side guards non-admin via <Navigate to='/enseignant'>.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates one TEST_v8 teacher via admin endpoint; left deactivated at teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v8 admin provisioning fully working. Regression file is test_examsecure_v8_admin.py (parallel-safe via session-scoped fixture). Previous v1-v7 regression files still present for exam/student flows.
